column2: 了 is the head and the bundled body, and 一 the arms stretched out across it, written last.
On the left a small tree: a short slanted stroke and a horizontal across its top, with the cloth 巾 hanging below. On the right a knife 刂 trims it: cutting to a plan is control.
A cart seen from above: the box 日 is the body, with a line through it for the axle and a wheel at each end.
A sound 音 sitting on top of the heart 心: the thought in your heart before it comes out as sound is your meaning, your intention.
The spear 戈 has a long horizontal; tuck the strong man 丁, just a hook, inside it under that line. A man guarded by a spear gets the job done and succeeds.
A hand 扌 swinging at a sturdy man 丁: to hit, to strike.
A fledgling beats its wings 羽 again and again under the bright 白 sky: that repeated flapping is practice.
A lid 亠 over two people 从 over a tree 木, with a bird 隹 beside them: a jumbled crowd of all sorts mixed together.
Silk thread 糹 running long like an underground river 巠: the warp threads that run through the cloth, and the classics that run through the ages. 巠 jīng says how to read it.
A hand 扌 welcomes a concubine 妾 arriving at the household: receiving someone, meeting and joining. 妾 qiè rhymes with the reading jiē.
A heron 雚 stands still and patient while it watches with its eyes 見: to look at, to observe.
Meat 肰 over the fire 灬: of course it cooks that way, naturally so. 肰 rán says how to read it.
The sun 日 stands straight over the foot 疋: upright and on the mark, correct, that is the way it is.
Water 氵 dashing wildly beside a musical instrument 敫 played fiercely: it stirs you up and gets you excited.
A round bean 豆 sitting beside 頁, the head and face: a bean-shaped thing on top of a body is the head, and 豆 rhymes with how it is read.
The crossroads split in two: 彳 on the left and 亍 on the right, the street you step along to go somewhere.
column3: It is a picture of a street intersection.

column2: Cutting jade 王 along the lines in it, as neat as the lanes of a village 里: its grain and inner order; 里 says lǐ.
Legs 癶 braced on top, a bow 弓 drawn, a weapon 殳 in the hand: let it fly and send it out.
Something heavy 重 only moves when you add strength 力; 重 also rhymes with how this is read.
A hill 阝 standing tough 艮 in your way: that is the limit you cannot pass.
A person 亻 shifting 更 to a more comfortable position: that is convenient and easy.
Coming down a hill 阝 is what 夅 means, to descend; 夅 also gives the sound jiàng.
A person 亻 bowing down low, with 氐 giving the sound dī.
A net 罒 laid on top, set down straight 直 where you want it: you place it there.
A tree 木 with two people 从 walking up to it from either side: they come over.
Earth 土 next to something bright and open 昜: a wide open patch of ground, the place where events happen.
Water 氵 poured on it until it shrinks and hardly resembles 肖 its old self: it fades away.
A person 亻 handing a hunting tool 弋 on to the next person: one takes over from another, generation after generation.
The sun 日 passing over a temple 寺 tells the hour.
An eye 目 with a tough, stubborn 艮 stare: that is the eye in your face.
A person 亻 watching over someone dull 呆 who cannot look after themselves: to protect and keep them safe.
Walking 走 away from your seat as you 己 get up and set out; 己 rhymes with how this is read.
